findings.title: No collectable payment path is configured
findings.evidence: lab-nova-omics has no payment provider customer and no invoice email.
findings.action: Collect a Stripe customer, verified payment method, or institutional invoice contact before handoff.

findings.title: Billing tax profile is incomplete
findings.action: Hold the invoice until country and tax ID requirements are complete.

findings.title: Invoice total exceeds the approved budget cap
findings.action: Require budget owner approval or reduce billable usage before collection.

findings.title: Usage spike should be reviewed before invoicing
findings.action: Review audit logs or usage annotations before sending the invoice.

findings.title: Compute overage lacks reviewer attestation
findings.evidence: lab-nova-omics used 120 compute hours against 40 included.
findings.action: Ask the project owner to attest that the compute jobs were authorized.

findings.title: Licensing export is not aggregate-anonymized
findings.action: Allow only aggregate-anonymized metadata exports for licensing revenue.

findings.title: Private research content cannot be included in licensing exports
findings.evidence: lab-nova-omics licensing packet includes private content.
findings.action: Remove private project content and regenerate the export manifest before billing.

findings.title: Data licensing requires a data-processing agreement
findings.evidence: lab-nova-omics has analytics licensing enabled without a DPA reference.
findings.action: Collect the institutional DPA before allowing analytics licensing billing.
